title: Blue,pink, and white outfit
description: This resource pack replaces the materials of the next installment of Metal Gear and certain items with blue, pink, and white colors, making your equipment look better.
body: Are you tired of the dark-colored materials used in Underworld Metal Gear? This resource pack replaces the materials of Underworld Metal Gear as well as some common items with blue, pink, and white colors, making your equipment look more attractive.
